title: alatiliparis decurrens
intro: Alatiliparis decurrens, commonly known as the Himalayan marsh orchid or the alpine marsh orchid, is a species of orchid native to the Himalayas. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alatiliparis decurrens include its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antioxidant activity, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
